title: koanophyllon cubense
intro: Koanophyllon cubense, commonly known as Cuban gold, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Koanophyllon cubense include its ability to act as a natural antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a potential treatment for wounds and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Koanophyllon cubense include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
